prompt:
PLAN 12 | THE OFFERING | 15 SECONDS

Create a horizontal 16:9 cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Two shots lasting five and ten seconds.
Cut to black at 14.5 seconds and hold the final half-second in silence.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his living shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

PROP REFERENCES:
Blade = {{PROP_BLADE}}
Staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

REFERENCE INTERPRETATION:
Preserve all character identities, masks, costumes, animal anatomy and prop designs. Apply the lighting below to every subject.

LOCATION AND LIGHTING:
A chamber concealed entirely by blackness.

One fixed hard overhead spotlight illuminates the closely grouped characters.

Cold-neutral light falls on their upper masks, shoulders, hands, the supported cat and the blade. Deep shadows shape the lower faces and clothing.

The background and all space beyond their bodies remain solid black. Architecture and floor stay unexposed.

Use waist-up and chest-up framing. Keep exposure fixed and the overhead spotlight constant.

BLOCKING:
Shahrnaz stands WEST, facing EAST.
Arnavaz stands EAST, facing WEST.
They begin seventy centimeters apart.

The camera remains SOUTH of their shared axis:
Shahrnaz is always SCREEN-LEFT, facing right.
Arnavaz is always SCREEN-RIGHT, facing left.

Zahhak stands NORTH, sixty centimeters behind the midpoint between them, facing SOUTH toward their actions. His mask is visible through the upper gap between their profiles.

Shahrnaz carries the cat in both hands.
Arnavaz holds the blade low in her RIGHT hand.
Her LEFT hand is empty.

The cat remains in Shahrnaz’s hands for the entire sequence.

SHOT 28A | 00:00–00:05 | RAISING THE CAT

50mm close composition from SOUTH, framing Shahrnaz’s upper torso and the cat, with Arnavaz’s near shoulder at the right edge.

Shahrnaz appears screen-left, facing screen-right.

She supports the cat’s chest with one hand and its hindquarters with the other.

Slowly raise the cat from mid-chest to upper-chest height, keeping it close enough for secure support. Its body remains naturally horizontal in her hands.

Her masked head inclines toward the animal, but her hands remain still rather than stroking it.

Arnavaz watches from screen-right.

SHOT 28B | 00:05–00:15 | THE FINAL TABLEAU

Cut to a 40mm waist-up three-person composition from SOUTH, remaining on the same side of the axis.

Shahrnaz occupies the LEFT third in profile, facing right.
Arnavaz occupies the RIGHT third in profile, facing left.

The cat is supported between them at upper-chest height, just below the center of the frame.

Zahhak stands farther back, his frontal mask visible in the upper central gap. His dark torso falls away behind the women.

Arrange the image around three points:
Shahrnaz’s mask at upper-left,
Arnavaz’s mask at upper-right,
the supported cat below and between them.

Zahhak’s higher, more distant mask watches over this arrangement.

Arnavaz takes one small step closer.

Make a very slow twenty-centimeter push-in, retaining both sisters, the cat and Zahhak’s mask within the composition.

Shahrnaz presents the cat slightly toward Arnavaz while maintaining full support with both hands.

Arnavaz extends her empty LEFT hand toward it.
Her RIGHT hand gradually lifts the blade from her hip into the lower-right portion of the composition.

The blade remains separated from the animal.
Both sisters remain calm and cooperative.

Behind them, one of Zahhak’s living serpents slowly lifts and turns its head beside his mask. Another makes a small muscular adjustment across his shoulder.

Hold the composition long enough for the relationship between all three characters to become clear.

At 14.5 seconds, before blade contact, cut directly to black.
Hold black and silence for the remaining half-second.

PERFORMANCE AND SOUND:
Steady breathing, quiet fabric, one soft footstep and a small natural movement from the cat.

The animal remains alive, continuously supported in Shahrnaz’s hands.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
